newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London steady in quiet trade..
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London steady in quiet trade..

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were steady in London on Wednesday following a record close in Hong Kong, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 28.62 at 12,915.07 by 1520 GMT, after the Hang Seng Index advanced 137.38 to a record close of 12,943.69 in Hong Kong earlier today.
Trade was described as quiet in London by dealers who said the U.S. Producer Price Index indicator in October failed to give the market direction.
"The market will now be looking ahead to economic data from the U.S. due Thursday and Friday to give a lead," said one trader.
This week's U.S. economic data includes consumer prices, jobless claims and retail sales on Thursday with industrial production figures due on Friday.
Heavyweight stock HSBC Holdings fell HK$0.75 from its Hong Kong close to be trading at HK$161.25 in London.
